# Steady Eddy Excavation LLC

Steady Eddy Excavation LLC provides professional excavation, grading, land clearing, and demolition services. Built on solid ground with 15+ years of experience.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** (575) 224-1886
- **Email:** Steadyeddyexcavation@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.steadyeddyexcavation.com/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/p/Steady-Eddy-Excavation-LLC-61573785675034/
- **Hours:** Mon - Fri: 7am - 6pm
- **Service Area:** Greater county area and surrounding communities within a 50-mile radius.

## Services Offered

### Site Preparation
Complete site prep including clearing, leveling, and stabilizing soil for new construction projects.
- Comprehensive land surveying and staking
- Vegetation and obstacle removal
- Soil stabilization and compaction testing
- Erosion control implementation

### Excavation & Grading
Precision digging and grading to ensure proper drainage and a solid foundation for your property.
- Foundation excavation for basements and footings
- Precision finish grading for landscaping
- Rough grading for driveways and pads
- Soil removal and relocation

### Land Clearing
Removal of trees, stumps, brush, and debris to transform raw land into usable space.
- Forestry mulching and brush cutting
- Stump grinding and root removal
- Rock and boulder clearing
- Debris hauling and eco-friendly disposal

### Demolition
Safe and efficient demolition of small structures, concrete removal, and debris hauling.
- Residential structure demolition
- Concrete patio and driveway removal
- Swimming pool fill-ins
- Safety fencing and site securing

### Drainage Solutions
Culvert installation, trenching, and french drains to manage water flow and prevent erosion.
- French drain design and installation
- Culvert pipe placement for driveways
- Retention pond excavation
- Swale grading for water diversion

### Driveway Installation
Building durable gravel or dirt driveways, from cutting the path to final compaction.
- New driveway cut-ins
- Gravel spreading and compaction
- Driveway repair and resurfacing
- Culvert installation for access
